name: Pistoles de Marie
descriptionTemplate: Arithmetica Limit and draws per turn +1. At the start of your turn, {Discover} 3 {overlay:Pistoles de Marie}—only one is Real. Picking the Real one grants its positive effect and dispels 1 random debuff, and resets this card's bonus. Picking a Fake one inflicts its negative effect, and your next {Discover} gains +1 Real option with doubled effects.
lore: Sweet and precious... or is it?
